justification: New 'Your project' summary above the SEPP/LEP/DCP tabs: project picker, key-controls table (LEP height/FSR/min lot size; DCP setbacks, site coverage, landscaping, open space, parking, solar) with each source's figure, words, clause/page and link passed through unchanged, a 'your proposal' box giving above/below/equal by arithmetic, and the site's triggered conditions. One shared project type for the summary and the DCP tab.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A shown figure, page, words or link differs from its source fixture; a missing value is filled; the comparison says anything but above/below/equal; a liability word appears; a picker type has no explicit mapping; the DCP tab and summary read different types.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Measured by deliberate breaks 2026-10-21 (code restored after each): comparison direction flipped -> 2 fail; liability word added to the not-found text -> 1 fails; 'Private open space' row pointed at landscaping_min -> 1 fails (passed all 20 before the every-row test was added); deep soil dropped from the landscaping row -> 1 fails. Clean: 21/21.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: /api/dcp/structured-controls (dcp_setback_controls rows), Planning Portal constraints for LEP figures.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reuses DcpStructuredControls helpers (formatValue, noNumberLabel, shortCitation) and /api/dcp/structured-controls; LEP figures from usePropertyAssessment constraints.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Three project-type vocabularies; one explicit mapping added. LEP has no page numbers: shown as 'LEP map' + link.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One component, two small libs, one mount point, a shared type store; no new API or fetcher.

functions.name: resolveControlsDevType
functions.input: the picked project type from the shared store
functions.output: the structured-controls dev_type, or null for types with no key controls
functions.if_none: no picked type at all falls back to the default new_dwelling

break_it.scenario: A source value is reformatted or rounded on the way to the table.
break_it.what_happens: The user reads a figure that is not in the plan.
break_it.how: Pass-through test asserts figure, page, words and link equal the fixture exactly.

break_it.scenario: A control has no figure in our data.
break_it.what_happens: A guessed or blank figure would mislead.
break_it.how: Row says 'Not found in our data — check the plan' with the plan link; no comparison box.

break_it.scenario: The summary and the DCP tab show different project types.
break_it.what_happens: Two different sets of controls for the same property.
break_it.how: Both read resolveControlsDevType from one shared store; test checks both call sites.

mutation_analysis: Four real mutations run, each caught (see observed_red). The every-row test reads an expected table written in the test, not the code's own table.

post_merge.manual_verify: Open a Hornsby or Woollahra R2 address: the summary shows height, FSR and DCP setbacks with page links; type a number and see above/below/equal.

residual_risk: Parking uses the DCP control only; LEP rows have no page or quote; the 'may apply' count line is not in v1.
